heros.infro: Wartislaw III was a Griffin duke of Pomerania-Demmin. Wartislaw successfully stopped a Danish invasion in 1234. In the North, Wartislaw was able to expand his sphere of influence up to the Ryck river into the territory of Hilda. Since he did not produce any children from his marriage, Pomerania-Demmin ceased to exist with his death.
heros.name: Wartislaw III, Duke of Pomerania
